_note: Narration for prob_live_demo.mp4 (68 s). 'at' = second where the line starts. Edit the text freely; voice.py fits each line into its slot.

lines.text: Meet prob. An AI agent tests our lab, end to end.
It asks a real question from biophysics: can a proofreading network beat the Hopfield bound?
The lead splits the work. The planner weighs gain against cost.
The verifier says no, and names the case that failed.
The next claim passes. Exact certificate.
Then a surprise: a verified result breaks an assumption. The lab reopens it.
A red team on another model tries to break it. It holds.
Now the agent opens a certificate, and re-runs it right in the browser.
Nudge one rate by 0.1 percent. Fail.
This run took six minutes. Real studies run for hours, round after round.
A human approves. The scribe writes the paper.
Eleven exact violations, among eighty-eight networks.
prob. Agents propose. Only code accepts.
